g.text: PR #2480 · Hand off a session to another agent when it runs out of usage
Fork only continued the same agent, so work stalled when its usage ran out;
now handoff starts another agent with the transcript and a summary written in time.
BEFORE
POST /api/sessions/{id}/fork
Resumes the agent's native thread.
The new session must be the source's own agent_type.
Usage limit reached
Claude cannot load a Codex thread, or the reverse.
Wait for the reset, or restart the work by hand.
Warnings before the limit
Claude allowed_warning: shown, never acted on.
Codex AccountRateLimitsUpdated: dropped as Noop.
AFTER
usage_warning -> request_handoff_summary
Once per usage window, via the work queue.
Sent after the turn ends; held while throttled.
POST /api/sessions/{id}/handoff
Launches target_agent; note has the transcript
commands and the latest ## Handoff summary.
Source stopped and paused (stop_source).
Hand off to Claude / Codex
Bar shown by usage_limited_since_last_input.
ForkDialog agent picker keeps the permission preset.
Not yet run against a live launcher. Model and permission preset carry over; other agent CLI flags do not.
